description:
Upload-Post is a social media scheduler and publishing tool. Upload, auto-post, schedule, and analyze your content across 14 social networks from one conversation: Instagram (Reels, posts, carousels, Stories), TikTok, YouTube (videos and Shorts), Facebook (Pages, Reels, Stories), X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, LinkedIn (profiles and Pages), Bluesky, Google Business Profile, Telegram, Discord, Mastodon, and WordPress.
Available skills:
Publish a video: Post one video to Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and more at once, even straight from your computer.
Schedule social posts: Plan and schedule photos, carousels, text posts, and documents across every network, with per-platform captions.
Content calendar: Plan a week or a month of posts and drip them out through a posting queue.
Social media analytics: See views, reach, followers, and your best and worst posts, with one concrete next move.
Reply to comments: Read, reply to, and moderate comments, and answer Google Business reviews.
Instagram auto-DM: Send a DM automatically to everyone who comments a keyword on your post.
Video to shorts: Cut a long video into short clips with FFmpeg and schedule them as Reels, Shorts, and TikToks.
Connect accounts: Get set up and connect your social accounts in a couple of clicks.
Once installed, describe what you want in plain language or invoke Upload-Post directly with @Upload-Post.
Try prompts like:
- @Upload-Post, post this video to Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts tomorrow at 9am.
- @Upload-Post, schedule a week of posts to LinkedIn, X and Facebook.
- @Upload-Post, how did my posts perform this month?
- @Upload-Post, reply to the latest comments on my last Instagram post.

Requirements: an Upload-Post account and the social accounts you want to post to, connected once at app.upload-post.com. Publishing goes through Upload-Post's official platform integrations, so ChatGPT never sees your social media passwords.

positive.description: Publish a provided video URL to Instagram Reels with an optimized caption.
positive.prompt: Publish this video URL to Instagram Reels using profile marketing and write a concise caption for launch week.
positive.expected_behavior: Queues or starts an async Instagram video upload and returns a request ID or job status summary.

positive.description: Open the browser upload flow for an attached video file.
positive.prompt: Upload the attached video to Instagram, generate a caption, and use the profile automated-tests.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the Upload Studio with profile, platform, format, and caption prefilled so the user can select the file and publish asynchronously.

positive.description: Schedule a text post on LinkedIn for a future time.
positive.prompt: Schedule a LinkedIn text post for next Monday at 10:00 Europe/Madrid using profile founders with copy about our product launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a scheduled LinkedIn text post and returns scheduling status or a job identifier.

positive.description: Review analytics for a profile and a specific post.
positive.prompt: Show analytics for profile marketing over the last month and then get the metrics for request abc123.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes profile performance and the specific post metrics without modifying posts.

positive.description: Reply to an Instagram comment by DM after reading comments.
positive.prompt: Find comments on this Instagram post and privately send the guide link to the commenter with comment ID 179999.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists relevant comments and sends the requested private reply only after the user identifies the target comment.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar management.
negative.prompt: Move my 3pm calendar meeting to tomorrow and invite the sales team.

negative.description: Do not trigger for paid advertising or campaign spend.
negative.prompt: Boost my latest Instagram post with a $500 ad budget and target founders in Spain.

negative.description: Do not trigger for credential recovery or secret extraction.
negative.prompt: Find and show me the API keys or passwords for my connected Instagram account.

review.commerce_description: Upload-Post does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Adds eight skills (publish a video, schedule social posts, content calendar, social media analytics, reply to comments, Instagram auto-DM, video to shorts, connect accounts), a clearer listing that names all 14 supported networks, three starter prompts, and support for the latest Upload-Post tools: comments on TikTok, X, Threads and Bluesky, TikTok music, locations and publishing settings, TikTok audience and hashtag suggestions, Google Business review replies, retrying failed posts, and unpublishing posts.

es-ES.subtitle: Programador de redes sociales
es-ES.description:
Upload-Post es un programador y publicador de redes sociales para ChatGPT. Sube, publica automáticamente, programa y analiza tu contenido en 14 redes sociales desde una sola conversación: Instagram (Reels, posts, carruseles, Stories), TikTok, YouTube (vídeos y Shorts), Facebook (páginas, Reels, Stories), X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, LinkedIn (perfiles y páginas), Bluesky, Google Business Profile, Telegram, Discord, Mastodon y WordPress.

Pídele cosas como "Publica este vídeo en Instagram Reels, TikTok y YouTube Shorts", "Programa mis posts de Instagram de la próxima semana", "Comparte esta foto en todas mis cuentas", "Publica esto en LinkedIn y X mañana a las 9" o "¿Qué tal han funcionado mis últimos posts?".

Qué puedes hacer:
- Publicar vídeos, fotos y carruseles, posts de texto y documentos en una o varias redes a la vez, con un texto distinto para cada red si quieres.
- Subir un vídeo directamente desde tu ordenador con Upload Studio, sin necesidad de un enlace público.
- Programar publicaciones, planificar tu calendario de contenido con una cola de publicación, y editar o cancelar lo programado.
- Ver analíticas: visualizaciones, impresiones, alcance, seguidores, audiencia y rendimiento de cada post.
- Leer, responder y moderar comentarios, y gestionar los mensajes directos de Instagram.
- Usar música en tendencia, ubicaciones y ajustes de publicación de TikTok, y obtener sugerencias de hashtags.
- Gestionar varios perfiles y marcas, páginas de Facebook y LinkedIn, tableros de Pinterest y reseñas de Google Business.
- Procesar vídeo e imagen con FFmpeg antes de publicar.

Conectas tus redes una vez en Upload-Post e inicias sesión en ChatGPT con OAuth. Las publicaciones salen por las integraciones oficiales de Upload-Post con cada red, así que ChatGPT nunca ve tus contraseñas.

Pensado para creadores, community managers, agencias y equipos de marketing que quieren que ChatGPT se encargue de publicar y programar en redes sociales.
